scope: Selected original invalid-token test body executed outside the test runner, using fresh stock Chrome contexts and fresh real PostgreSQL, Mailpit and API services for each launch. Passive host request/response observation; application, test body, timers and retry policy unchanged. This is attribution, not a comparative benchmark or release admission.

test.title: Redirects to /login when token is wrong

policy.clock: Bun performance.now; host event delivery times, not in-browser timer firing times

invalidAttempts.reason: Probe imported both isolated test runners in one process; duplicate Playwright Test initialization rejected before browser launch. Corrected probe imports only the selected engine matcher. No timing observation admitted.

conclusions: The application makes four failed current-user requests before redirecting, separated by the three configured-library default backoffs. Both engines preserve this behavior.
The nominal seven-second serial application retry budget cannot be removed by faster locator polling or transport while preserving ordinary real-time execution.
Do not alter this corpus retry policy, remove the test, or count explicit clock control as an ordinary engine speedup. Continue measuring complete suites with this application wait included.
limits: Two diagnostic launches per engine; no confidence interval, tail estimate or speed comparison.
This is a single test body outside the runner, not all 62 original backend tests or a complete-owner performance gate.
Docker service CPU and memory are outside the browser watchdog tree; no resource-admission claim.
Host response-to-next-request intervals include event delivery and other work; they are not exact timer execution or idle CPU measurements.
This does not prove a bound on the final preparation-inclusive suite metric or prevent gains elsewhere in the suite.
